children: WAGA ENERGY SA - SELECTED TO BUILD, OWN AND OPERATE A RENEWABLE NATURAL GAS (RNG) PRODUCTION UNIT AT ECO-HILL LANDFILL IN ATKINSON, ILLINOIS
UNIT WILL HAVE AN INITIAL CAPACITY OF 3,000 SCFM
FACILITY WILL BE ABLE TO PRODUCE UP TO APPROXIMATELY 610,000 MMBTU OF RNG PER YEAR
UNIT IS EXPECTED TO REACH COMMERCIAL OPERATION IN 2028
FACILITY WILL TURN GAS NATURALLY GENERATED BY LANDFILL INTO RENEWABLE ENERGY FOR HOMES AND BUSINESSES IN REGION
WAGA ENERGY WILL FINANCE UNIT AND MARKET RNG IT PRODUCES; IN RETURN, ECO-HILL LANDFILL WILL RECEIVE A SHARE OF REVENUE GENERATED BY THESE SALES
